name: FXQuote
description: An FX spot rate quotation generated by SVC-007 (Treasury Services, CAP-002.04 promoted) for a specific FX trade enquiry. Linked to ENT-040 (FXTrade) via trade_id FK. Tracks the full lifecycle from firm quote generation through to acceptance, expiry, or rejection. Multiple FXQuote records may exist per FXTrade (re-quote on expiry of previous quote). Created in PH-060 (Price Quotation). The accepted FXQuote's firm_rate is the binding executed rate denormalised onto FXTrade.rate. Introduced by JRN-014.
owning_capability: CAP-002 (Commercial Banking — Treasury Services, CAP-002.04 PROMOTED)

fields.name: indicative_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, 6 decimal places. Non-binding indicative rate shown to the client in PH-059. Sourced from Bloomberg FXGO at enquiry time.
fields.derived_from: Bloomberg FXGO mid-rate + indicative mark-up at time of PH-059 enquiry

fields.name: firm_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, 6 decimal places. Legally binding all-in rate at which the bank will transact if the client accepts within valid_until. Includes approved spread. Immutable after status = quoted.
fields.derived_from: Bloomberg FXGO mid-rate at firm-quote time + approved full mark-up for client tier

fields.name: spread
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, 6 decimal places. Bank FX margin: difference between firm_rate and Bloomberg mid-rate at quote time. Captured for MiFIR best execution disclosure.
fields.computed_from: firm_rate minus Bloomberg FXGO mid-rate at firm-quote time

fields.name: valid_until
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. quoted_at + 30 seconds. Enforced server-side by SVC-007.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: quoted | accepted | expired | rejected. Transitions: quoted → accepted (client confirms within valid_until); quoted → expired (valid_until exceeded); quoted → rejected (client declines).

fields.name: quoted_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable. Used to derive valid_until and for MiFIR reporting.

fields.name: accepted_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Populated when status = accepted. Must be < valid_until. Immutable.

relationships.description: FXQuote belongs to one FXTrade via trade_id FK.

design_decisions.decision: spread is stored as a computed field derived from firm_rate minus Bloomberg mid-rate at quote time.
design_decisions.rationale: Captures spread as a computed, auditable value from observable inputs rather than a dealer-entered figure. Provides independent cross-check for MiFIR best execution disclosure. The derived_from provenance chain is preserved for regulatory review.

design_decisions.decision: valid_until is enforced server-side by SVC-007 at the point of processing the acceptance request.
design_decisions.rationale: Server-side enforcement prevents bypass of the UI countdown. Stale-rate execution is both a market risk and a MiFIR compliance breach.
